'''Logovik''' was one of the guards of the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. He was actually a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], who, along with his other minions, infiltrated the Cog Hive Seven to track down [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Iram Radique]] and gather information about his dealings. Logovik was a muscular man known for causing trouble. Like his accomplices, which included [[Crete]], [[Galway]], [[Tyson]], [[Olyphant]], [[McCane]], [[Webberly]], and [[Augustine Smight]], Logovik was supplied with a false backstory in order to pose as a prison guard inside the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. However, [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Sadiki Blirr]] discovered the plot and confronted the compromised guards. Hoping to receive a pardon, Logovik divulged the names of all his co-conspirators in front of Jabba, who was present at the meeting via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. Under Warden Blirr's orders, two prison gangs, the [[Bone Kings]] and the [[Gravity Massive]], began to brutally murder Jabba's spies. The leader of the Bone Kings, [[Vasco Nailhead]], crushed Logovik's skull using a sharpened femur, and proceeded to take a bite of his face.
